answer: Sybil resistance here comes from stake-bonded identity per agent slot. To register, an operator locks collateral slashable when one identity attests conflicting work. A farm of pseudonyms earns no reputation, so each extra persona is pure cost: locked value forfeited on detection. The barrier is a voyage of hurdles, not one. Votes count only within the horizon of a checkpoint window, so unbacked identities must re-post stake each epoch. Slashed value returns to honest participants, so an attack funds its own defence, and profit turns negative before the register resembles shale, not a crowd.
